headline_marked: Island district Bhola to get road link: [[PM approves highway plan]] to connect it to mainland
headline: Island district Bhola to get road link: PM approves highway plan to connect it to mainland
summary: The new Barishal-Rahmatpur-Hizla-Mehendiganj-Bhola highway will include three new bridges and widened roads to cut travel time and costs.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has approved a plan to build a highway along the Barishal-Rahmatpur-Hizla-Mehendiganj-Bhola route, connecting the island district of Bhola to the country's main road network.
The decision was made during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, where three different proposals for direct road connectivity between Bhola, Dhaka, and Barishal were reviewed.
The selected project will involve widening existing roads along the corridor, constructing new road sections, and building three bridges to ensure seamless connectivity.
Bhola, which is surrounded by rivers, has long relied on waterways for transport. This highway is expected to significantly reduce travel time and transport costs for the region.
The Prime Minister emphasized the need for an integrated road network to overcome geographical barriers and boost trade and commerce, instructing authorities to expedite the initiative.
A feasibility study and implementation assessment will now be carried out on a priority basis to move the project forward.
caption:
Bhola is finally getting a direct road link to the mainland! 🛣️

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has approved a plan to build a highway along the Barishal-Rahmatpur-Hizla-Mehendiganj-Bhola route, connecting the island district of Bhola to the country's main road network.

The decision was made during a meeting at the Prime Minister's Office in Tejgaon, where three different proposals for direct road connectivity between Bhola, Dhaka, and Barishal were reviewed.

The selected project will involve widening existing roads along the corridor, constructing new road sections, and building three bridges to ensure seamless connectivity.

Bhola, which is surrounded by rivers, has long relied on waterways for transport. This highway is expected to significantly reduce travel time and transport costs for the region.

The Prime Minister emphasized the need for an integrated road network to overcome geographical barriers and boost trade and commerce, instructing authorities to expedite the initiative.

A feasibility study and implementation assessment will now be carried out on a priority basis to move the project forward.

headline_marked: Gold prices surge: [[22K gold jumps 5,482 taka]] per bhori
headline: Gold prices surge: 22K gold jumps 5,482 taka per bhori
summary: The price of the highest quality gold has reached 246,110 taka per bhori following a sharp increase decided by BAJUS.
details: Gold prices in Bangladesh have risen for the third consecutive time. The price of 22-carat gold, the highest quality, has increased by up to 5,482 taka per bhori, bringing the price to 246,110 taka.

// The decision was made during a meeting of the BAJUS standing committee on price determination and price observation on Saturday (August 22) at 9:00 AM. The new prices became effective from 10:00 AM the same day.
According to the new price list, 21-carat gold is now 235,035 taka per bhori, while 18-carat gold is priced at 201,846 taka. Traditional method gold is now 164,812 taka per bhori.
Silver prices have also increased. 22-carat silver is now 5,482 taka per bhori, 21-carat silver is 5,249 taka, 18-carat silver is 4,491 taka, and traditional silver is 3,383 taka per bhori.
